LanguageData.XylCommandFlyDesc: Start flying. Flying grants increased movement speed and allows traveling over some obstacles.
LanguageData.XylCommandAutoFlyDesc: The character will automatically start flying if they are moving and the fly ability is off cooldown.
LanguageData.XylCommandAutoFlyDraftedDesc: While drafted, the character will automatically start flying if they are moving and the fly ability is off cooldown.
LanguageData.XylCommandMilkDesc: Allow other characters to milk this character.
LanguageData.XylCommandMilkOnlyWhenFullDesc: Only allow milking when this character's breast milk is full.
LanguageData.XylAtavismChanceDesc: The chance of the carrier having an extra gene due to the atavism gene.
LanguageData.XylAtavismGenesDesc: The extra genes added to this character by the atavism gene.
LanguageData.XylGenderRatioDesc: The chance of characters of this xenotype being male or female.
LanguageData.XylMilkProductionDesc: The number of milk items this character can produce in a day if well-fed.
LanguageData.XylRageChanceDesc: The chance of this character flying into a rage when damaged. While enraged, the character is uncontrollable and automatically charges at nearby enemies.
LanguageData.XylSubstituteCapacityAlwaysDesc: {0} is used instead of {1} for stat calculations.
LanguageData.XylSubstituteCapacityLowerDesc: {0} is used instead of {1} for stat calculations if it is lower.
LanguageData.XylSubstituteCapacityHigherDesc: {0} is used instead of {1} for stat calculations if it is higher.
LanguageData.XylAllowsFlightDesc: Whether winged characters can fly while wearing this item.
LanguageData.XylSettingTooltip_allowBackerBackstories: Backer backstories can have fixed names that clash with the naming schemes of some of the new xenotypes added by this mod. This setting controls which xenotypes can get randomly assigned backer backstories.
LanguageData.XylSettingTooltip_fixLactationBugs: There are multiple bugs in the base game that make lactating characters eat more than expected, which can be a balance problem for Bossaps. This setting controls fixing those bugs to reduce the nutrition consumption for lactating characters.
LanguageData.XylScenPartForcedXenotypeSummary: {0} have a {1} chance to start with xenotype: {2}
LanguageData.XylDocileThresholdReached: No rebellion because interval is over {0} days
LanguageData.XylIngestedBehind: {PAWN} needs to consume {NUTRITION} nutrition worth of {0} per day, and is currently {DURATION} behind.
LanguageData.XylWetnessNeedModifiedByTemperature: Wetness fall rate is {FACTOR} of normal due to the current temperature of {TEMPERATURE}. At this temperature {PAWN} will need to spend {HOURS} hours a day in water to stay wet.
LanguageData.XylBecomesDormantAtTotalTendQuality: Becomes dormant at total tend quality
